title: Plum-Blossom Needle Tapping and Ginger Juice Rubbing for Hair Loss Prevention
author: Yingshuyi Zhou

steps.title: Perform Routine Postoperative Care
steps.instruction: Provide all patients with routine postoperative care and health management based on a continuous care plan.

substeps.instruction: Administer routine acid-suppressive therapy and gastric mucosal protection therapy within the first month after surgery.
Provide lifestyle guidance on postoperative diet, rest, and exercise.
Implement diet management: follow the MBS dietary plan with a daily fluid intake of 1500 to 2000 milliliters, avoiding spicy and irritating foods.
Ensure regular sleep schedules and emotional regulation.
Encourage appropriate daily physical activity to enhance fitness.
Conduct guidance sessions on the day of enrollment (face-to-face), the 7th day after surgery (telephone/video call), and at 1 month and 3 months after surgery.

steps.title: Perform Plum-Blossom Needle Tapping
steps.instruction: Apply scalp meridian tapping using plum-blossom needles according to GB/T 21709.2-2021 and the 5th edition of Acupuncture Science.

substeps.instruction: Disinfect thinned areas of the scalp and corresponding acupoints with 2% povidone-iodine, followed by 75% alcohol.
Gently tap the plum-blossom needle on thinned scalp areas and selected acupoints using brisk wrist movements.
Tap each area/acupoint for 2-3 minutes until local skin redness, swelling, and a small amount of petechiae appear.
Perform treatment once daily from the 1st to the 3rd day after surgery (discharge day), then once a week for a total duration of 3 months.

steps.title: Perform Ginger Juice Rubbing
steps.instruction: Apply fresh ginger juice rubbing to areas of sparse hair.

substeps.instruction: Remove the outer skin from a fresh, juicy ginger root.
Repeatedly rub the ginger root on areas with sparse hair until a local burning sensation is felt.
Rinse off ginger residue with warm water after 30 minutes.
Perform treatment once every three days for a total duration of 3 months.

steps.title: Perform Combined Therapy
steps.instruction: Administer both interventions for a total duration of 3 months.
